literal: Yesterday departed my lover; and I, seven days we are, body having turned pale.
translation: It was only yesterday that my lover departed; yet, my body has been pale with grief for seven days now.
modern: என் காதலர் நேற்றுத்தான் பிரிந்து சென்றார்; ஆனால், என் உடலோ பசலை நோய் வந்து ஏழு நாட்கள் ஆனது போலப் பசந்து போய்விட்டது.
explanation: The heroine speaks of her intense longing and the distortion of time in her lover's absence. He left only yesterday, but her body has already turned pale with the grief of separation (pasalai). To her suffering mind, this physical change makes it feel as though seven long days have already passed. The couplet beautifully contrasts the objective reality of time with the subjective experience of pain.
